author: ai
text: Russia's net exports in 2024 were 63.9% of its oil production and 22.2% of its gas production (Energy Information Administration, 2024), and 39.6% of its wheat production and 92.8% of its potash production (FAOSTAT, 2024). Russia's mines produced an estimated 43.3% of world palladium in 2025 (USGS, 2025), and Iran was the main supplier of its major arms imports, at 50.9% in 2021–2025 (SIPRI, 2021–2025). Its population was 143.5 million people in 2025 and its GDP was $2.56 trillion in 2025 (World Bank, 2025).
